findings.breaking_input: The question "status" followed by 200000 spaces and then "x". The board regex passes its first alternative because `status` matches, arcContext is false, and the anchored regex runs.
findings.why: `\s*\??\s*$` has two adjacent `\s*` separated by an optional `?`. With a long run of whitespace and a non-matching tail, V8 backtracks quadratically. One request to the local door can pin the event loop. This is a new regex on a path every question crosses. Nothing in the diff caps the question length or collapses whitespace before matching.
findings.fix: Cap the length of q before matching, and collapse whitespace first. Or use a single quantifier: `/^\s*(status|board|live)(\s*\?)?\s*$/` with a length guard.

findings.breaking_input: state.lanes contains `{lane: "c++"}` or `{lane: "("}`, or an entry that is `null`. The question is "how to send an email" or "what is the capital of France".
findings.why: arcContext is now called for most questions, and also from the action-refusal path. It builds a RegExp from an unescaped lane name read from disk, and `l.lane` is dereferenced with no shape check. A bad lane name or row now throws SyntaxError or TypeError for unrelated general questions. Before this diff, only the lane-burn answer built that regex, and only after a match. A throw means the Ask door fails instead of escalating to the model. This is the lane-name grammar and "unreadable row" class: a value read from disk used as code or a key.
findings.fix: Escape the name, and skip rows whose `lane` is not a string matching `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`. Wrap the lane scan in a try/catch that returns false. Apply the same guard to the unescaped regex in the lane-burn answer.

findings.where: .claude/scripts/hq/lib/face/ask-offline.mjs:askOffline refusal branch `arcContext(q, state || {})` and the matcher loop
findings.breaking_input: state.lanes is an object, a string, or absent in a partially built state (for example `{lanes: {}}`), and the question is "how to kill a process".
findings.why: `(s.lanes || []).some` throws on any truthy non-array. Before the diff the refusal branch never touched state. Now a wrong-shaped lane list turns a refusal or escalation into an uncaught exception. This is the same "wrong-shaped source" class the lane already fixed elsewhere.

findings.breaking_input: Delete or skip any three of the new GENERAL checks. The floor is hand-kept at 52, and the mutant block also imports a copy of the module from os.tmpdir().
findings.why: The hand-kept count is a twin of "never hand-keep a count the code can print" and "a floor one above the real count". The mutant is written to tmpdir, so any relative import added to ask-offline.mjs later breaks it with an unresolved import. The throw then happens before the RAN line, which reads as a crash, not a FAIL.
findings.fix: Derive the floor from `33 + GENERAL.length - 1 + 3`, or from a counter. Write the mutant beside the source, or rewrite its relative imports to absolute file URLs. Assert that the mutant imported.
